prompt: Rewrite this note as a clear, friendly notice for apartment residents: 'The hallway painting starts Tuesday. There will be workers. Bikes and boxes are in the way. Move them Monday night. We think the job ends Thursday, but the weather may affect drying.' Preserve the uncertainty. Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text:
**Notice to Residents**

Hallway painting will begin on Tuesday. Please be aware that workers will be present, and bikes, boxes, and other items may obstruct the work area. Kindly move these items by Monday evening. We expect the project to be completed by Thursday, although drying time may vary depending on the weather. Thank you for your cooperation and for helping us keep the work area safe and accessible.
